[Yotang]
There lives a fairy on the 3rd floor of Kunlun.
She is so famous for her beauty
that she even got a fan club.

[Yotang]
Of course, I am the master of the fan club.
How about joining the fairy fan club?
I'm not that interested!!
I'll join it right away!!

[Yotang]
What! I'm going to tell on you!

[Yotang]
Oh, aren't those....!
the materials for the Flower of Fairy?
Have we met before? You already know everything...

[Yotang]
Anyway, do you want me to make the Flower of Fairy?

[Yotang]
^FF0000Please be aware that
the refinement on the materials will all disappear
if you once combine those.^000000
No, next time.
Make it right now!!

[Yotang]
You'll regret it!

[Yotang]
You're speedy!
You deserve to be a master of the fanclub for the next term.
Combining... ... ...

[Yotang]
Here, the Flower of Fairy.

[Yotang]
See you on the fan meeting!

[Yotang]
Huh? You don't have enough
materials for it..
Aren't you wearing Bandana?
Check it out!

[Yotang]
Bring me all the materials,
if you want to get the Flower of Fairy.

[Yotang]
If you bring me ^0000FF100 Transparent Celestial Robes, 100 Soft Silk Cloth,
1 Wedding Bouquet, 1 Violet Dyestuffs
and ^0000FF1 Bandana^000000 which you can find at a store,
I will make you a ^0000FFFlower of Fairy^000000.

[Yotang]
You can meet the fairy soon
for there will be a fan meeting
in the near future.
The Flower of Fairy is necessary
for joining the fan meeting. Everyone wears it.

[Yotang]
If you bring me some materials
I'll make it for you.

[Yotang]
I need ^0000FF100 Transparent Celestial Robes, 100 Soft Silk Cloth,
1 Wedding Bouquet, 1 Violet Dyestuffs
and ^0000FF1 Bandana^000000 which you can find at a store,

[Yotang]
Your bag is too heavy, isn't it?
Come to me again
after emptying your bag.

[Drunken Man]
Hey... you wanna fight?!
He seems to be drunken badly. What should I do?
Just ignore him.
Fight!

[Drunken Man]
Why are you ignoring me?
Are you afraid of me?

[Drunken Man]
What... you're weaker than me.
Go and reach the higher level!

[Drunken Man]
Hold! I need some armor to wear.
That's it, Necktie, Necktie...

[Drunken Man]
Once I wear the Necktie on my head,
I will be no match for you!
You must be nervous.
Hmm! Where is the Necktie?

[Drunken Man]
Oh, you're having the materials for Necktie! give them to me!!
No way!
Here you are.

[Drunken Man]
Ohh, you are scared!
I won again!!

[Drunken Man]
Great, wait for a moment!
Combining... ch...ch... ...

[Drunken Man]
Drunk...drunk.... Zzzzz...

He zonked out as soon as
he finished it.
Let's just take the Necktie.

[Drunken Man]
Huh? Where are all the materials gone?
Did you take it back that you're so afraid of me?

[Drunken Man]
Hey, go and get
^FF00001 Cobaltblue Dyestuff, 30 Oil Papers, 100 Fabrics, 20 Spools^000000!

[Drunken Man]
I will beat you off wearing the legendary Necktie!
I won't.
Let's go and get them.

[Drunken Man]
Are you dropping out?
Did I win again?

[Drunken Man]
I'm telling you once more
for you might forget it, dumbhead!

[Drunken Man]
^FF00001 Cobaltblue Dyestuff, 30 Oil Papers, 100 Fabrics, 20 Spools^000000!
Hurry! I'll be futzing around with others.

Necktie is heavier than I thought.
Seems like the very legendary Necktie.

- Wait !! -
- You have too many items, so it's -
- impossible to have more. -
- Come to me again -
- after emptying some of it. -

[Hat Girl]
Isn't the unique hat much better
than the common hairbands?
I still prefer hairbands!
Hat is the best!

[Hat Girl]
Wear your boring hairband for the whole lifetime!

[Hat Girl]
You have a good sense!
I thought I would make
a trendy hat.

[Hat Girl]
I will give you an honor,
to be a fashion superstar,
if you bring me the materials for it.

[Hat Girl]
Oh! you're bringing ^0000FFthe materials for Hair Brush^000000.
Do you want me to make it now?
I think the hairband is better...
Yes, please make it!

[Hat Girl]
Wear your boring hairband for the whole lifetime!

[Hat Girl]
Okay, I'll do it right away!
Ch ch ch... combining...ch ch.

[Hat Girl]
Here, it's done!
Now you're the fashionista!

[{0}]
I got the Hair Brush.
...but it makes me sad.

[Hat Girl]
Huh? Don't you want to be
the best fashionista?
You don't have enough materials?

[Hat Girl]
To make the latest style ^0000FFHair Brush^000000,
I need ^0000FF1 Mixture, 1 Scarlet Dyestuffs,
50 Solid Shells, 5 Eluniums,^000000
also 1 ^0000FFAxe^000000 with 4 sockets on it.

[Hat Girl]
What are you doing? Hurry!

[Hat Girl]
Here is one tip for you.
You can easily get Solid Shells and Elunium from the monsters.

[Hat Girl]
You're carrying too much stuff.
Come again after emptying your bag.

[Bebete]
A fake angel? Go away!

[Bebete]
The real angel
is not as weak as you.

[Bebete]
Oh, the angel came again.
Are you quite satisfied with ^FF0000Statue Of Baby Angel^000000, aren't you?

[Bebete]
Ah! Hey, angel~ angel~

[Bebete]
Please show me the Statue of Baby Angel!
I heard every angel has it!
Statue of Baby Angel?

[Bebete]
Did you lose it?
Do you want me to make it for you?
No, thanks.
Yes, I want it now.

[Bebete]
Oh... it's not easy to make a living!

[Bebete]
Wow, you already know all the materials, angel.

[Bebete]
You're lucky. I have one statue on going.
So you don't need to wait for long.
I got the ^FF0000Statue of Baby Angel^000000.

[Bebete]
See you again, my angel~!

[{0}]
Hmm... I guess I was fooled by that little kid.

[Bebete]
Hey, I don't see
any materials in your bag..

[Bebete]
Hey, angel...

[Bebete]
Wow, the angel!

[Bebete]
Are you a real angel? Have you been to heaven?
What bullshit!
Let's keep the childhood innocence!

[{0}]
Angel and heaven? It's all made up!

[{0}]
There's nothing. Everything is lie!

[Bebete]
You're a devil! a monster! an idiot!

[{0}]
Of course. I used to dance with the dragon and zebra
on the vanilla-taste clouds.

[Bebete]
That's just what I've been imagining!

[Bebete]
Please show me the Statue of Baby Angel!
I heard every angel has it!

[Bebete]
Oops, did you lose it?
Do you want me to make one for you?

[Bebete]
I made it several times before
for the angels like you.

[Bebete]
I can make it with ^FF0000500 Feather Of Birds, 1 Holy Water, 10 Muscovite, 1 Heaven Ring and 1 Shining Stone^000000.

[Bebete]
Okay, hurry!

[Bebete]
A fake angel? Go away!!

[Bebete]
The real angel has
the wings on the head!

[Bebete]
What are you carrying that much, angel?
I can't give you the item
because your bag is too full.

[???]
Hmm..Hm..
It seems my transformation into the child's appearance is successful.

[???]
Human! I am here to ask you some help.

[???]
I am the great King Froggie VII!

[King Froggie VII]
but I think you're not strong enough to help us.
Go and train more!

[King Froggie VII]
Over lvl 65 human will be fine for us.

[???]
I am the great king, Froggie VII..
I need your help!
Just ignore it.
Let's help him.

[{0}]
Talking frog...

[{0}]
Now I've seen everything.

[King Froggie VII]
Croaking...Croaking...

[{0}]
What can I help you?

[King Froggie VII]
Our great frog race is now endangered because many travellers came here and take our eggs as a kind of souvenirs. I even heard there are many left on the ground here and there, so I need your help. Please bring back ^FF0000100 Spawn^000000.

[{0}]
Sure, I will.

[King Froggie VII]
I will be waiting for you!

[King Froggie VII]
What are you doing here?
Go and get ^FF0000100 Spawn^000000!

[King Froggie VII]
Oh, you brought all of them!

[King Froggie VII]
Thank you so much, {0}.

[King Froggie VII]
By the way, we have another urgent matter. So I would ask you one more help.

[King Froggie VII]
Frogs are healthy food to the snakes.

[{0}]
I know well.

[King Froggie VII]
Well, that's good. Aren't you feel sorry for our race?

[King Froggie VII]

[King Froggie VII]
I'll be waiting for your news!

[King Froggie VII]
I'm waiting for your good news.
It would be a piece of cake for you
to kill ^FF000050 Side Winders^000000. Keep it up!

[{0}]
I'm back.

[King Froggie VII]
You seemingly killed all the Side Winders!

[King Froggie VII]
You became an example for the young frogs. Thank you again.

[King Froggie VII]
Therefore, I'm considering adding your outstanding exploit to our frog's history book. But I need your evidence for your work.

[King Froggie VII]
Please bring me ^FF0000 100 ^000000 ^FF0000Venom Canines^000000 from the snakes.

[{0}]
I'm happy to be added in the history book. I'll go and get them.

[King Froggie VII]
Obedient, hard-working... I hope I have a loyal frog like you.

[King Froggie VII]
How about ^FF0000100 Venom Canines^000000?
Hurry, it's a rare opportunity to be added in the frog history book!

[King Froggie VII]
Oh, you brought Venom Canines! Now, I'm able to put you in the frog history book officially.

[{0}]
That's good for me.

[King Froggie VII]
I have a better news!

[King Froggie VII]
I found a great method to keep our race while I was looking up the history book!

[King Froggie VII]
The answer was in the frog history book. In the old days, the great King Froggie III made a secret medicine enabling us to use a hiding skill from the snakes.

[King Froggie VII]
I should have known this earlier...
Please get me ^FF000050 Scaled Shells^000000.

[King Froggie VII]
It's not easy to get, but I'm sure you can do it.

[King Froggie VII]
Still here? Go and get ^FF000050 Scaled Shells^000000! Please hurry!

[King Froggie VII]
Excellent!
You're like the great King Froggie III in his young days!

[King Froggie VII]
You are already the hero for our frogs! If I have a child, I would marry you up with my child.

[{0}]
Ah... No, thanks.
^FF0000(Are you telling me to marry a frog???)^000000

[King Froggie VII]
Thanks to you, the population of frog has increased but we're short of food.

[King Froggie VII]

[King Froggie VII]
Now, what are you doing, our hero?
Go and get ^FF000050 Argiopes^000000!

[King Froggie VII]
My hero, are you going to starve us to death?
Go and bring us ^FF000050 Argiopes^000000!

[King Froggie VII]
I think I saw you a while ago, but now you became the hero for the frogs...

[King Froggie VII]
It was really lucky for me to ask you a favor.

[King Froggie VII]
I'd like to give you a reward, our hero. But your bag is now too heavy.
